name: Your Company
tagline: Wrought-iron grilles for windows, balconies and doors

listing.description: A website for a grille workshop: a pattern catalogue laid out like a playbill, three price levels styled as stalls, circle and box tickets, and measuring bookings.

seo.title: Your Company — wrought-iron window and balcony grilles, Tashkent
seo.description: Grilles for windows, balconies and doors, from plain square bar to ornate scrollwork. Free measuring, made in 10 days, powder-coated, 5-year guarantee.
seo.answer: Your Company makes wrought-iron grilles for windows, balconies and doors in Tashkent: a plain 12 mm square-bar grille from 650,000 UZS per m², with forged details from 950,000 UZS, fully ornamental from 1,600,000 UZS. Free measuring, 10 working days, 5-year guarantee. Phone +998 71 200-07-02.

sections.title: Your Company
sections.eyebrow: Wrought-iron grilles · Tashkent · now taking orders
sections.subtitle: Grilles for windows, balconies and doors that protect the house without hiding its facade. We draw a pattern for your windows, forge it, powder-coat it and fit it in one day.

sections.label: The workshop
sections.title: A grille is the first thing guests see
sections.text: We are in Yunusabad: four smiths and an artist. Every pattern is first drawn over a photo of your facade so the grille suits your windows, not a catalogue. Ground-floor grilles come with an opening leaf for fire safety.

items.title: “Strict grid”
items.text: A plain grid with no ornament, for modern facades and offices.

items.title: “Sunrise”
items.text: Bars fan out from the lower corner around a forged sun.

items.title: “Vine”
items.text: Leaves and bunches cut from sheet and hand-chased.

items.title: “Girih”
items.text: Stars and polygons, as on old madrasa doors.

items.title: Measuring
items.text: We come free of charge, measure the openings and photograph the facade.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw the pattern on the photo and revise it until you approve.

items.title: Forging
items.text: We bend, forge and weld in the workshop in 7–10 days.

items.title: Coating
items.text: Blasting, primer and oven-cured powder coat.

items.title: Fitting
items.text: Anchored in one day, and we clean up after ourselves.

items.quote: We asked for a grille that would not turn the window into a cage. They drew “Sunrise” — the neighbours keep asking where we got it.
items.author: Nodira

items.quote: Measured on a Saturday, fitted a week and a half later. The paint has survived the winter.
items.author: Rustam

items.a: No, measuring in Tashkent is free even if you decide not to order.

items.q: Can the grille be opened from inside?
items.a: Yes, ground-floor grilles get a lockable opening leaf, as fire safety requires.

items.q: How is the price worked out?
items.a: By grille area in m² and pattern complexity; we give the exact figure after the sketch.
Five years on welds and powder coating.
